content.json:
# Netcraft Takedown — Operations

Takedown records, important notes, and group tag changes from the Integration Gateway (`NetcraftTakedown_CL`). Latest-state panels use `NetcraftTakedown_Latest` (latest `takedown` event per `Subject`, including `ChangeType` `new` or `update`). `IsAuthorized` and `IsEscalated` are booleans. Note panels include added, updated, and deleted. Select a latest-state row to drill into that `TakedownId` / `GroupId` timeline.

parameters.name: SelectedTakedownId
parameters.description: Set by clicking a row in the latest-state table, or type a TakedownId / GroupId manually.

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Events = count() by EventType
| order by Events desc
content.title: Events by type

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(AttackType)
| summarize Takedowns = count() by AttackType
| top 15 by Takedowns desc
content.title: Latest takedowns by attack_type (top 15)

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Takedowns = count() by IsMaliciousDomain = iff(isempty(tostring(IsMaliciousDomain)), "unknown", tostring(IsMaliciousDomain))
| order by Takedowns desc
content.title: Latest takedowns by malicious domain

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Takedowns = count() by IsMaliciousHostname = iff(isempty(tostring(IsMaliciousHostname)), "unknown", tostring(IsMaliciousHostname))
| order by Takedowns desc
content.title: Latest takedowns by malicious hostname

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Takedowns = count() by Status
| order by Takedowns desc
content.title: Latest takedowns by status

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    ActionRequired = countif(isnotempty(ActionRequired) and ActionRequired != "no"),
    IsEscalated = countif(IsEscalated == true),
    NotAuthorised = countif(IsAuthorized == false),
    DomainAttackTrue = countif(IsMaliciousDomain == true),
    HostnameAttackTrue = countif(IsMaliciousHostname == true)
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Action required", "Count", ActionRequired),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Escalated", "Count", IsEscalated),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Not authorised", "Count", NotAuthorised),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Malicious domain", "Count", DomainAttackTrue),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Malicious hostname", "Count", HostnameAttackTrue))
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Count = tolong(Metrics.Count)
content.title: Highlights (action required / escalated / authorised / malicious domain and hostname)

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Event volume over time

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ChangeType,
    Subject,
    TakedownId,
    GroupId,
    AttackType,
    Threat,
    Status,
    IsMaliciousDomain,
    IsMaliciousHostname,
    IsAuthorized,
    IsEscalated,
    ActionRequired,
    CustomerLabel
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Latest takedown state (by subject) — click a row to drill down

content.json:
## Selected takedown / group drill-down

Showing events for `TakedownId` or `GroupId` = **{SelectedTakedownId}**. Clear the parameter (or pick another latest-state row) to change selection.

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where isnotempty('{SelectedTakedownId}')
| where tostring(TakedownId) == '{SelectedTakedownId}' or tostring(GroupId) == '{SelectedTakedownId}'
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ChangeType,
    Subject,
    TakedownId,
    GroupId,
    AttackType,
    Threat,
    Status,
    IsMaliciousDomain,
    IsMaliciousHostname,
    IsAuthorized,
    IsEscalated,
    ActionRequired,
    CustomerLabel
content.title: Selected — latest takedown state

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty('{SelectedTakedownId}')
| where tostring(TakedownId) == '{SelectedTakedownId}' or tostring(GroupId) == '{SelectedTakedownId}'
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventType,
    EventId,
    Subject,
    TakedownId,
    GroupId,
    AttackType,
    Threat,
    Status,
    IsMaliciousDomain,
    IsMaliciousHostname,
    IsAuthorized,
    IsEscalated,
    ActionRequired,
    NoteId,
    NoteBody,
    TagValue,
    TagUpdate
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Selected — event timeline

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty('{SelectedTakedownId}')
| where tostring(TakedownId) == '{SelectedTakedownId}' or tostring(GroupId) == '{SelectedTakedownId}'
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Selected — volume by event type

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(ActionRequired) and ActionRequired != "no"
| project TimeGenerated, ChangeType, TakedownId, GroupId, AttackType, Threat, Status, ActionRequired, IsAuthorized, IsEscalated, IsMaliciousDomain, IsMaliciousHostname
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Waiting for customer

content.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType in ("takedown-important-note", "takedown-important-note-updated", "takedown-important-note-deleted", "group-important-note", "group-important-note-updated", "group-important-note-deleted", "group-tag-change")
| project TimeGenerated, EventType, Subject, TakedownId, GroupId, NoteId, NoteBody, TagValue, TagUpdate
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent notes and group tag changes
